QUESTIONS PEOPLE ASK BEFORE HIRING US FOR SEO
Answers written and reviewed by Khalid Farhan, founder. Last reviewed November 2026.
How much does SEO cost in Galway?
Retainers from €1,500 a month. The exact figure depends on the size of the opportunity and the amount of work, so we do a free audit first and quote from that. There is no charge for the audit.
Do you work with businesses in Galway?
Yes. We work with businesses in Galway and across Ireland. Most of the work is done remotely with regular calls and a monthly report; Dublin-based clients can meet us in person.
How long does SEO take to show results?

Most clients see meaningful ranking movements within 3–6 months. Significant traffic and revenue impact typically comes at the 6–12 month mark, depending on domain authority, competition, and how aggressively we execute.
Do you guarantee first-page rankings?

No ethical SEO agency can guarantee specific rankings — Google's algorithm is outside anyone's control. What we guarantee is a rigorous, transparent process and measurable progress. We track dozens of KPIs beyond rankings, including organic traffic, conversions, and revenue.
How much does SEO cost?

Our SEO retainers start at €1,500/month for smaller businesses and scale based on the size of the opportunity, competition level, and the volume of work required. We offer a free audit before quoting so the investment is always justified.
Can you work with our existing website?

Yes. We work with most platforms including WordPress, Webflow, Shopify, and custom-built sites. Our technical audit identifies platform-specific issues and we work with your development team or handle fixes directly.
